factors.label: Relative strength 7d
factors.note: Method idea (relative strength vs peers): strong only if the coin ROSE over 7d AND beat the median 7d move of its peer cohort (same DEX / launchpad on the same chain, read from GeckoTerminal). Derived: relStrength7dPp = min(7d change, 7d change − cohort median), which is > 0 only when both hold. The cohort median is cached in KV (refreshed hourly, never used past 6h, labelled stale with its age); an unreadable cohort leaves the factor null with the reason.

thresholds.note: rose and beat the peer median by ≥ 10 pp
rose and beat the peer median
did not both rise and beat the peer median

whenMissing.evidence: Token is {ageHours} old — a 7d price change needs 7 days of trading, so relative strength does not apply yet (age never penalises).

hysteresis.note: Schmitt trigger on the score → band step (2026-11-20): a token whose previous analysis (score_history, ≤ maxAgeHours old, same mode) was placed by the score bands keeps that tier while the new score is within ±margin of the line between the two adjacent tiers. Gates, caps, coverage and the S/A requirements still apply after it. Held up, the displayed score shows the bottom of the held band with raw beside it; held down, it is clamped to the top of the held band — so a higher displayed score never means a lower tier.

chainSets.note: Chain-specific factor sets: Robinhood launch tokens are scored only on signals Robinhood Chain sources can supply (no pump.fun feed / Helius factors). Base, Monad and Ethereum (v3) have their own launch and established sets, built only from fields their sources fill (docs/chains/<chain>.md); factors no source on the chain provides are absent. Ethereum's sets are the Base sets on the Ethereum sources (ethereum-rpc / ethereum-sim / etherscan) without the launchpad factor: no Ethereum launchpad is registered, so it would be permanently null. Solana established tokens use established_solana (2026-11-24): the shared established set plus the wallet-cluster meter (top10_share 8 → 3, wallet_clusters 5); Robinhood keeps established until its funding is readable.

zeroActivity.note: When a source answered and the token's activity is genuinely zero (no buyers, no trades, no volume, no liquidity, curve at 0%), these metrics are set to 0 and their factors score their minimum points, status live, evidence 'no activity'. Null stays reserved for a failed source or a field a source does not provide.

removedFromSolanaLaunch.note: v2.3 §3: no Solana source supplies these, so they are absent from the Solana launch set (not null): fees vs mcap (three.ws has no fees field), only-huge-candles (no per-candle trade counts), holders vs makers (DexScreener's API exposes no makers; Helius has no holder count). Their weight moved to dev-buy share, VOL/MC, launch retrace, identical candles, top holder and fresh wallets.

v24.note: v2.4: basics are gates, not points. Mint / freeze authority, LP lock / launchpad, sellable, owner renounced and upgradeable proxy carry weight 0 (a pass adds nothing; a fail is a gate or cap). Their weight was redistributed proportionally to holders, flow and launch mechanics / liquidity; round-trip loss stays scored, in flow.
